recent_learnings.lesson: Port orchestration shapes (hermes swarm) onto existing authority idioms: enforce declared-but-unenforced gates (greenlight, DAG, concurrency, checkpoint auth) in-DB, ship dark.

MSourcing OneDrive checkout: node_modules dehydration blocks tsx/tsc/eslint (>6min, procs vanish); recursive grep/cp/find + background agents hang (lose TCC). Use the single-file Read tool + bare-node .mjs ports of the .mts contract to verify structure.

Extend the queued->dispatching never-auto-send trigger to a new channel via a SEPARATE channel-guarded trigger, never by editing the existing WhatsApp one (zero blast radius). Mint an email RFC Message-ID from the SENDER mailbox domain (RFC 5322), not the recipient.

recent_learnings: Run FULL npm test before claiming a rock green: it surfaced 3 latent gate drifts + a missing declared dep (server-only) absent from local node_modules.
DB-test harness: pass role-switched temp-row ids across roles via GUC current_setting, not cross-role temp-table SELECT (permission denied for pg_temp table).
Rocket-fuel doctor MUST run before long planning workflows so Codex availability shapes the plan-review path (learned when Codex hit usage-limit mid-engagement).

recent_learnings.lesson: Permission denials came in transient bursts; probe with a different action class before assuming deliberate user block.
grep substring hits are not import proof — verify with git grep -F against HEAD before committing 'required' files.
MSourcing: human-likeness gate = separate event table with no send path + type-constrained outbound + block-only gate at send route; approval hash must never be mutated post-approval.

A state doc's 'all prep done / ready to deploy' claim is not proof; verify deploy prereqs against actual files. MSourcing DEPLOY-STATE said Fly-ready but had no fly.toml and only a dev Dockerfile (CMD npm run dev).
Sandbox blocks ~/.fly (perms EPERM) and the tsx CLI IPC pipe; flyctl/vercel must run in Tony's shell or via dangerouslyDisableSandbox; tests run via scripts/run-tests-sandbox.mjs (node --import tsx).

flyctl auth: browser CLI login expires fast; use a personal access token in a gitignored file + export FLY_API_TOKEN=$(cat file). flyctl hangs on telemetry POST — set FLY_NO_METRICS=1 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 and run slow ops in background.

Fly 'trial has ended, please add a credit card' fails apps create with rc=1 — a billing gate like the GitHub one. Check Fly account billing BEFORE driving a deploy; Tony's card must be added at fly.io/trial.

Concurrent Workflow runs sharing one non-worktree checkout corrupt git: parallel cherry-picks/resets wiped each other's staged state mid-op. Give any git-mutating workflow agent isolation:'worktree', or serialize with no other repo access.

harvestapi/linkedin-profile-search is fuzzy keyword search, not URL fetch: a specific person only surfaces via structured firstNames[]/lastNames[] input (or dev_fusion by-URL). The dialog hid those fields — backend supported them all along.

TS tsc -p narrows a mock-capture let assigned only inside a closure to 'never' at reads. Fix by reading through an `as` assertion (not an annotated-assignment alias, which inherits the never) + explicit !==null guard.

GDPR erasure TOMBSTONES a candidate in place inside workspace_state.state->'candidates' (doesn't remove it); any derived/mirror table MUST skip tombstoned elements (hash-id lookup in the suppression table) or it re-materializes erased PII on the next save.

rocket-fuel rf-codex protocol gate parses only meet-rN labels for the round number; a prefixed label like meet-p1r5 is invisible, so the gate falls back to a stale earlier receipt. Keep meeting labels meet-r<N> continuing one counter per statedir.

MSourcing migration count/tip/ledger-sha + ARIA_EXPECTED_MIGRATION_* are all computed dynamically (deploy-fly.sh, /api/ready, docs-truth); adding a migration needs zero count/tip doc edits — only a new test:db-* + ci.yml job if it adds an RLS/privilege surface.

GitHub Actions budget exhausted on mysticalsin repos: every CI job fails at startup, zero steps, no logs ('Actions budget is preventing further use' annotation). Check the annotation before diagnosing red CI as code failure.

Fly manual deploy of a new migration MUST recompute+stage ARIA_RELEASE_SHA/ARIA_EXPECTED_* secrets (deploy-fly.sh:316-330 node algorithm) BEFORE the app deploy, or /api/ready releaseIdentity/migration go false; deploy-fly-2.sh omits this step.

0033 reject_candidate_erasure_reimport BLOCKS erasing a candidate whose identifier a SURVIVING candidacy shares (the scrubbed-state write reintroduces the just-tombstoned value → 23514). So any derived-layer 'purge tombstoned identity shared by survivor' logic is unreachable dead code — the delete-GC on candidacy delete covers it.

Postgres hoists a STABLE function out of an EXISTS predicate and evaluates it even against zero rows; a helper that RAISES without a workspace secret (candidate_erasure_identifier_hmac) then fires spuriously. Gate it behind a prior no-helper existence check (tombstones exist?) before calling.

Identity resolution: link people ONLY on linkedin.com/in/ profiles. GitHub URLs can't distinguish user vs org; email/phone are shared. Under-link (over-split) rather than ever merge two humans' PII — a false merge is a GDPR incident.
